newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Taiwan says decision pending on stock index trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan says decision pending on stock index trade.

text.p: Finance Minister Paul Chiu reiterated on Saturday that a decision by the end of April would be reached on whether to allow Taiwan investors to trade Taiwan stock index futures on the Singapore Mercantile Exchange and the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
He told Reuters Financial Television, "In general, we take a positive attitude towards that. I think, in general, we will give our approval," said Chiu.

Asked whether an existing ban on offshore trading of Taiwan stock index futures reflected a fear of capital flight, Chiu said: "I think opening of futures transactions will not depend on the fear of capital flight...I think every regulator wants to see a hedge-dominated market rather than a speculative market.".
